assumptions.statement: The info-frontend service is the sole consumer of the Backdrop Read and Write APIs within the GovUK environments.
assumptions.quote: The info-frontend is the only service within the GovUK environments that makes connections to the read and write backdrop APIs.

assumptions.statement: Fastly is the primary caching layer that resolves traffic for the performance endpoints and interacts with the Backdrop APIs when cache misses occur.
assumptions.quote: Those names will resolve to fastly, which will serve what is required if cached, if it is not cached it will update its cache by hitting the appropriate backdrop endpoints

assumptions.statement: The production Backdrop components (database, worker, and APIs) are currently hosted on specific Carrenza infrastructure (performance-mongo cluster and api-1/api-2 nodes) rather than the GovUK PaaS.
assumptions.quote:
Backdrop database  (Carrenza performance-mongo cluster)
  - Backdrop Worker, Read & Write API  (Carrenza api-1 & api-2 nodes)
